Notice under Sections 27F, 28(2), 28(2)(a), 28(2)(b) and 29(1)(a) (i) (ii) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance

it is hereby notified that the number of candidates that are to be nominated by a recognized political party or an independent group in the first Nomination Paper for each ward indicated in the corresponding entry in Column 3 of the Local Authority indicated in Column 2 of the Schedule hereto, situated in the Administrative District indicated in Column 1 of the said Schedule, shall be as indicated in the corresponding entry in Column 4 of the said Schedule, that the number of candidates that are to be nominated in the Supplementary Nomination Paper shall be as indicated in the corresponding entry in Column 5 of the said Schedule, that the total number of candidates that are to be nominated for the Local Authority shall be as indicated in the corresponding entry in Column 9 of the said Schedule, that the minimum number of women candidates that are to be nominated in the First Nomination Paper shall be as indicated in the corresponding entry in Column 6 of the said Schedule, that the minimum number of women candidates that are to be nominated in the Supplementary Nomination Paper shall be as indicated in the corresponding entry in Column 7 of the said Schedule, that the number of women representation corresponding to the 25% of the total membership of the local authority shall be as indicated in the corresponding entry in
